name: Privilege log entry check
summary: Before a draft privilege log goes to review counsel, the paralegal gets an entry-by-entry check against counsel’s approved format and role map, and a list of logged documents’ attachments with no entry. It checks metadata only: review counsel makes every privilege call and writes or approves every description.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI’s own published map of law-firm work, and its own rules for legal work prepared for a lawyer: counsel’s approved records as the only measure, metadata checked and never substance, and every open point written as a line for the named lawyer to confirm.
